name: AREX-2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: hybrid: Gated DeltaNet linear attention with full gated attention every 4th layer (16 of 64); partial RoPE
notes:
ADDED 2026-11-26. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, not a new base model: same config.json (64 layers, 16 of 64 full-attention, hidden 5120, 4 KV heads x head_dim 256), same 262,144 context, so the 65,536 B/token KV figure is inherited and was checked against the base record [[models/qwen3-8-27b]] rather than re-derived. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; evidence rows are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-29.

PARAMS: safetensors.total for this repo is 27,356,728,560 (27.357B); Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B reports 27,781,427,952 (27.781B). The card itself says '27B' and 'dense'. params_b is this repo's own index total, not the inherited one. active_params_b is set equal to params_b because the model is dense (AREX-2 trains all language weights, no MoE), so per-token active count IS the total. The 0.42B gap against the base is not explained on the card; it is recorded, not resolved.

HARDWARE GATE: 27.36B dense, ~13.7 GiB at 1 GiB per B of fp16 weights ... clearer: params_b x 0.5 GiB = 13.7 GiB, inside the 128 GiB ceiling. But DENSE means expert-offload buys nothing: this is a 4-bit single-card model (~16-17 GiB at 5 bpw), and its 262k-context KV grows at 64 KiB/token, so long context is the real constraint, not weights.

EVIDENCE SHAPE: the card prints no Qwen3.8-27B base row, so there is NO base-vs-tuned delta here. The rows that justify the record are MLE-Lite 81.8 vs the catalog's previous best at <=40B active (sage-a1-5 65.2, frontis-ma1-30b 53.03) and DeepSearchQA 93.8 vs 89.5. It LOSES GAIA (92.2 vs xyz-aquila-mini 97.1) and BrowseComp against ling-3-1-flash (84.0 vs 91.67); those losses are in the benchmark rows.

benchmarks.name: MLE-Lite (Any Medal, 3 seeds)
benchmarks.config: Card HTML table 'Coding and machine-learning engineering', AREX-2 row (27B, dense, on Qwen3.8-27B). Card footnote defines the metric: 'MLE-Lite reports Any Medal averaged over three seeds'. No Qwen3.8-27B base row is printed, so there is no base-vs-tuned delta for this row. The comparison used here is to the catalog's MLE rows at <=40B active: sage-a1-5 65.2 (row named 'MLE-Lite' with metric text unstated) and frontis-ma1-30b 53.03 ('MLE-Bench Lite Medal Average') - METRIC EQUIVALENCE NOT VERIFIED for sage, so treat this row as 'beats the printed open >=100B rows in the same table' (Kimi-K3 72.7, Naive-N0.5-Flash 73.7) rather than as a clean size-class upset. RECORDED, NOT RESOLVED.

benchmarks.name: DeepSearchQA
benchmarks.config: Card second HTML table 'General agentic reasoning and deep research', AREX-2 row inside the 'Small models (<=40B)' group; no base row printed. Catalog comparators are xyz-aquila-mini 89.5 (metric F1 per that card) and inkling-2-mini 85.3; the AREX-2 card prints no metric definition, so F1-vs-accuracy is UNVERIFIED. Loses to Kimi-K3 95.0 and Claude Fable 5 94.2 printed in the same table.

benchmarks.name: BrowseComp
benchmarks.config: Same table, AREX-2 row. LOSES to ling-3-1-flash 91.67 in the catalog and to GPT-5.6 Sol 90.4 and Kimi-K3 91.2 printed on the card. Listed for honesty: the record's case rests on MLE-Lite and DeepSearchQA, not on this row.

benchmarks.name: HLE (text-only subset)
benchmarks.config: Same table; unmarked values use the text-only subset per the card footnote, starred values are full-set and not comparable. LOSES to sage-a1-5 55.1 (HLE w/ tools, different setting) and axion-1-0-35b 52.8.

benchmarks.name: GAIA
benchmarks.config: Same table, 'Small models (<=40B)' group; no harness printed on the card. LOSES to xyz-aquila-mini 97.1 and sage-a1-5 95.1 in the catalog - and xyz's 97.1 carries a documented ReAct search harness, so the two are not like-for-like. Beats Tongyi-DeepResearch-30B 70.9 and Qwen3.5-35B 80.0 printed in the same group.

benchmarks.name: Frontier-CS (188-task Agent Track)
benchmarks.config: Card first HTML table; card footnote: 'Frontier-CS is the 188-task Agent Track'. No catalog comparator exists for this test, so it is recorded but not used to justify the record. Loses to GPT-5.6 Sol 76.4, Claude Opus 4.8 74.5, GPT-5.5 72.1 in the same table.
